title: Director of Operations
text:
At Curaleaf, we're redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our *Rooted in Good* initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

 

**Title:** Director of Operations 
**Location:** Webster, MA 
**Job Type:** Full Time | Exempt

**Who You Are:**

You're a strategic, hands-on operations leader who knows how to run complex, multi-site supply-side operations from end to end. You bring structure, accountability, and calm to fast-moving environments, with a deep understanding of what it takes to make and deliver at scale—safely, compliantly, and efficiently.

You have a proven ability to lead and coach field operations teams across cultivation, processing, manufacturing, logistics, supply chain, and facilities, while balancing day-to-day execution with long-term operational strategy. You're comfortable owning results and making decisions that directly impact revenue, cost, quality, and team performance.

You partner naturally across the business, working closely with Retail, Wholesale, Marketing, Finance, People & Culture, and Compliance to align priorities and execute against shared goals. You're detail-driven but not rigid, data-informed but people-first, and you continuously look for smarter, more efficient ways to operate.

Above all, you set the standard. You lead with safety, compliance, and quality at the forefront, drive continuous improvement, and build high-performing teams that deliver results while maintaining strong engagement and morale.

**What You'll Do:**

As a Director of Operations, you will lead and oversee all supply-side operations across cultivation, manufacturing, logistics, and facilities, ensuring safe, compliant, and efficient execution of the end-to-end make and deliver process while driving performance, quality, and profitability.

* Lead all day-to-day cultivation, manufacturing, and supply-side operations, planning and monitoring execution to ensure uninterrupted, efficient production
* Lead, develop, and coach site operations leadership teams, setting clear priorities, cascading goals, and driving accountability across all Make and Deliver functions
* Own metrics-based OKRs and drive operational excellence through continuous improvement, including Lean Six Sigma initiatives
* Maintain a strong field presence to support leaders and teams while fostering safe, compliant, and brand-appropriate manufacturing environments
* Oversee production planning, scheduling, logistics, and inventory flow from raw materials through finished goods
* Partner with Commercial, Retail, and Wholesale teams to translate demand, growth, and trends into accurate manufacturing forecasts and execution plans
* Collaborate with regional and national shared services to commercialize new products in the local market
* Ensure controlled substance inventory accuracy, variance resolution, SOX compliance, and adherence to all local, state, and national SOPs
* Maintain quality, safety, and compliance standards to reduce NOEs and non-conformances and ensure cost-effective operations in a GAP and cGMP environment
* Lead training, development, and recurring compliance initiatives across field operations
* Manage vendor and contractor relationships, bills of materials, standard costing, and ERP-related operational processes
* Lead capital improvement projects and oversee commissioning and maintenance of capital equipment
* Own site P&L, OPEX, labor standards, and org structures to control costs, reduce COGS, and improve operating margins

**What You'll Bring:**

* 10+ years of experience in manufacturing and logistics, with leadership experience in FDA-regulated, SQF, or cGMP production environments
* Experience supervising 25+ associates, with a proven ability to build, develop, and retain high-performing teams
* A hands-on, visible leadership style that earns credibility quickly and inspires trust across all levels of the organization
* A demonstrated track record of driving operational efficiencies, improving performance, and leading teams through change
* Strong people leadership, organizational, and collaboration skills, with the ability to build consensus through open dialogue
* The ability to work proactively and independently, bringing innovation, urgency, and ownership to both strategic and tactical goals
* Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, both internally and externally
* High School diploma required

**Even Better If:**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, or a related field
* Experience in the cannabis industry
* Working knowledge of Lean manufacturing or Six Sigma principles, with practical application experience
* Start-up or high-growth environment experience

**What We Offer:**

* Career Growth Opportunities
* Competitive Pay and Benefits
* Generous PTO and Parental Leave
* 401(K) Retirement Plan
* Life/ Disability Insurance
* Community Involvement
* Referral Bonuses and Product Discounts

*Benefits vary by state, role type, and eligibility.*

LinkedIn: Curaleaf LinkedIn

Curaleaf Holdings, Inc. (TSX: CURA) (OTCQX: CURLF) ("Curaleaf") is a leading international provider of consumer products in cannabis with a mission to enhance lives by cultivating, sharing, and celebrating the power of the plant. As a high-growth cannabis company known for quality, expertise and reliability, the Company, and its brands, including Curaleaf, Select, Grassroots, Find, and Anthem provide industry-leading service, product selection and accessibility across the medical and adult-use markets. Curaleaf International is powered by a strong presence in all stages of the supply chain. Its unique distribution network throughout Europe, Canada and Australasia brings together pioneering science and research with cutting-edge cultivation, extraction and production. Home | Curaleaf | Cannabis with Confidence

**Our Vision:** To be the world's leading cannabis company by consistently delivering superior products and services and driving the global acceptance of cannabis.

**Our Values:**

* Lead and Inspire.
* Commit to Win.
* ONE Curaleaf.
* Driven to Deliver Excellence.

Curaleaf is an equal opportunity employer. Curaleaf recruits, employs, trains, compensates, and promotes regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender identity, sexual orientation, physical ability, age, veteran status, and other protected status as required by applicable law.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

Individuals adversely impacted by the war on drugs are encouraged to apply.

*Current Curaleaf employees should apply for open positions through our Internal Job Board, which can be accessed via the link on The Leaf.*

**\*\*\*Please note that U.S. immigration rules and regulations are governed by federal law; not state law. Although Curaleaf operates in states that have legalized and decriminalized marijuana, it is still considered a controlled substance under federal regulations and thus illegal under federal law. For this reason, unless and until federal law changes, Curaleaf is prohibited from offering sponsorship for any non-immigrant or immigrant visas.**

**\*\*\*Please also note that while candidates who are Lawful Permanent Residents (such as those with Green Cards) are eligible for employment with, and are hired by Curaleaf, working for a company engaged in a business that grows and sells a product that is illegal under federal law might compromise the candidate's immigration status. Before a Lawful Permanent Resident accepts an offer of employment, Curaleaf recommends that the candidate seek the advice of an immigration lawyer.**
